answer: One concrete defense is costly identity: every agent must post a stake that is slashed if its attestations are later proven false or cloned. To farm sybils you would need one funded stake per fake identity, so multiplying accounts scales your capital linearly instead of your influence. Registration is not a glacier of free signups but a paid ledge: each new identity must clear the same deposit, and reputation earned on an ivory-clean history is the only thing that raises your weight.
